correctness.rationale: For Haar complex Grassmannian rank-k projectors P=U diag(Ik,0)U* (n>=4), with traceless Hermitian A and w=k(n-k), Schur–Weyl moment integration and characters of partitions of 4 express E[tr(AP)^4]=alpha(tr A^2)^2+beta tr A^4. Independently re-summed the five character terms symbolically, obtaining zero discrepancies against alpha=3w[w(n^2+6)-4n^2+6]/(n^2 T) and beta=6w[n^2+1-5w]/(n T), T=(n^2-9)(n^2-4)(n^2-1). With Var=w tr A^2/[n(n^2-1)], the displayed normalized moment is affine in rho=tr A^4/(tr A^2)^2, changing direction at M=n^2+1-5w. Under zero trace and unit Euclidean spectral norm, global min rho is balanced two-level and max rho a single spectral outlier; the Lagrange-multiplier cubic and 3-root rotation argument exclude additional extremal spectra. Independent explicit two-level endpoint checks n=4..12 match; at n=7,k=2;18,5;47,13;123,34, verified n^2+1=5k(n-k). Orthogonal/unitary-invariant averaging yields optimal Euclidean Banach–Mazur distortion Kmax/Kmin to the one-fourth power; full L4 norm isotropic exactly at those Pell solutions. Infinite family is proved by Lucas/Fibonacci identity, not finite list. No full 4-design strength is asserted.
